name: Rho
role: Union flag officer; devised the Kaelor’s Rift battle plan
description: The Union flag officer who devised the battle plan for the Battle of Kaelor’s Rift — dividing the enemy fleet using misdirection and electronic warfare to isolate key elements while Sentinel teams infiltrated the shipyard. At the crisis of the battle she awaited an order to retreat from Captain Alric Tann, who gave none.
